calculation.description: Ranks a 10-session reversal scaled by inverse 20-session volatility, then gates its amplitude by the lagged 60-session percentile rank of aggregate five-session cross-asset realized volatility. Cross-sectional clipping is at the 10th/90th percentiles and the resulting signal is smoothed over five sessions. All inputs are lagged through the decision date.

validation.regime_notes: Passes benchmark-wide absolute IC >= 0.0070 and absolute ICIR >= 0.0840. Recent 365-session IC/ICIR were 0.086565/0.292019; 750-session values were 0.031185/0.109335; 1260-session values were 0.014108/0.050556, indicating meaningful long-run regime concentration risk. Small cross-section uncertainty is addressed by 1768 daily observations across all 15 tradable instruments.
